name: agents
description: Live subagents, background shells, Monitor watches and cron timers: an AGENTS band above the prompt (main model, each run with its model or command, task and status, watches with time left, crons with their next fire, skills fired, ☕ while idle sleep is held), an /agents-info pane with a Who view (cost, tokens, time and a pixel mascot per run, picked from a pool for its state), a Code view (the files touched, as a map of nodes in edit order) and a Peers view (the other agents of this herdr workspace, this session's HERDR-ORCH spokes grouped under their requests), a toast when one finishes and ALL DONE when the last one does.

band.title: AGENTS band above the prompt
band.description: on: a row while subagents or background shells run, lingering 10 s after the last one; off: no band (the /agents-info pane stays)

toasts.title: Toast when a subagent or shell finishes
toasts.description: on: one toast per subagent or background shell that ends (finished, failed or killed); off: none. Never for the main loop.

keepEnded.title: Finished and failed runs kept in the pane
keepEnded.description: How many ended runs (finished or failed, subagents and shells) the pane keeps, newest first; older ones are dropped. /agents-info clear drops them all. 0 keeps none.

caffeinate.title: Hold idle sleep while work runs
caffeinate.description: on: while any subagent, background shell or watch runs, one `caffeinate -i -t 600` child holds idle sleep (re-armed while work runs, stopped when the last one ends; ☕ on the AGENTS row); off: none.

sound.title: Chime with ALL DONE
sound.description: off: the ALL DONE toast only (default); on: a rising chime (the peers mod's) with it. Needs toasts on.

summaries.title: Code map summaries
summaries.description: edit: each node's third line is taken from the edit itself (the Edit's first changed line, the Write's first line); haiku: reserved, drawn as edit until a model summary is approved; off: the file's folder instead.
